about: Worked examples published by an ASEAN Member State authority for the ASEAN-Korea FTA, encoded as inputs to the AKFTA check with the result the source states. Written before the check was run on them (D949). No published AKFTA origin rulings with a product, materials and a result were found (D949).

miti.title: MITI Malaysia, Guide to the ASEAN-Korea FTA, Part 5: Guide to Rules of Origin (worked examples)

notes: The guide gives no HS code for the washing machine; 8450.11 is chosen here. Its colour television is HS 8528.12 of an older edition; 8528.72 is the HS 2022 subheading. Its de minimis example gives no values; the figures below are chosen by the author of this file and fixed before the run.
Example of non-qualifying operations: the guide lists dry cleaning, ironing and labelling; ironing has no key in Rule 8, so the operations given are cleaning and marking.

cases.where: Part 5, Rule 4, example (a) washing machine, build-down
cases.states: RVC 62 % ((1,000 - 380) / 1,000); qualifies as an originating good of Korea

cases.where: Part 5, Rule 4, example (b) washing machine, build-up
cases.states: RVC 52 % ((370 + 150) / 1,000); qualifies as an originating good of Singapore

cases.where: Part 5, Rule 7, example colour television, accumulation
cases.states: RVC 50 % with the Thai tuner counted as originating in Korea; originating good of Korea

cases.where: Part 5, Rule 8, example of non-qualifying operations
cases.states: No: dry cleaning, ironing and labelling in Korea of fabrics imported from Bangladesh do not confer origin

cases.where: Part 5, Rule 10, example baby carriage (values chosen: FOB 100, aluminium bar 55, handle grip 10)
cases.states: Does not meet the CTC rule on the handle grip alone, but a grip at 10 % of the transaction value or less is disregarded under de minimis, so the CTC rule is met

cases.where: Part 5, Rule 10, example silk yarn (values chosen: FOB 100, weight 100, raw silk 93, silk thread 7)
cases.states: Does not meet the CTC rule on the silk thread alone, but a thread at 7 % of the weight or less is disregarded under de minimis

cases.where: Part 5, Rule 3, example tuna from a Thai factory ship
cases.states: The tuna is an originating good (wholly obtained)

cases.where: Part 5, Rule 3, example crude oil extracted in Brunei
cases.states: The crude oil is an originating good (wholly obtained), whoever the exploration company is
